headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on Ecolab, Raises Price Target to $295
summary: Wells Fargo  analyst Jason Haas   maintains Ecolab (NYSE:ECL) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $275 to $295.
